title: POST /checkout_sessions — create session
context: This is the highest-correctness-risk endpoint — totals math and cart authority. Escalate to Opus directly given prior notes on totals/guardrail logic risk.
objective: Implement session creation per ACP spec: accept line_items (required), buyer (optional), fulfillment_address (optional); return an authoritative cart with computed totals.
scope_in: POST /checkout_sessions accepting the request shape from PRD §5.2
Server-side price lookup from catalog — never trust a client-supplied price
Totals computation: subtotal, tax (flat placeholder rate, documented), total
Response includes payment_provider block with provider=razorpay, razorpay_order_id=null (not yet created)
Session persisted to Firestore with status=created
Idempotency-Key header support: same key within a time window returns the existing session, does not create a duplicate
scope_out: No update/complete logic yet — creation only
acceptance_criteria: POST with a valid line_items array returns HTTP 201 and a session with correct computed totals
POST with an empty line_items array returns HTTP 400 with a clear error message
POST with a client-supplied price different from catalog price ignores the client price and uses server-side catalog price
Sending the same Idempotency-Key twice returns the same session id both times, confirmed via a test hitting the endpoint twice
Session document appears in Firestore with status=created
